NodeService（C#）

Service introduction

NodeService is responsible for a full set of operations on internal nodes* of the main graph (Graph). It provides functions such as node creation (including copying), deletion, connection and disconnection, parameter reading and writing, binding name setting, node activation/initialization/update, etc. All methods are asynchronous and need to be called after OpenGraphAsync (to maintain timestamp consistency).

namespace: AtomSdk.Services

Entrance: client.Node

Applicable scenarios

  • Add or delete nodes in the opened main graph;

  • Connect multiple nodes in series into a computing pipeline through connection ports;

  • Read or modify the node’s initialization parameters and operating parameters;

  • Set the Runtime binding name for the port so that the Runtime phase reads and writes data by name;

  • Run a node alone to debug output (ActivateNodeAsync / UpdateNodeAsync);

Recommended calling order

client.Graph.OpenGraphAsync(graphName)  (First open the graph to get the timestamp)
        ↓
CreateNodeAsync          (Create node)
        ↓
SetNodeParamDataAsync    (Set parameters,Can be called multiple times)
        ↓
ConnectNodesAsync        (Connect node port)
        ↓
InitialNodeAsync         (Initialize node,Optional)
        ↓
ActivateNodeAsync        (activate/Run a single node,Polling waiting for completion)
        ↓
GetNodePortDataAsync     (Read output port data)

Interface detailed explanation

CreateNodeAsync(…​)

// original JsonElement version
Task<JsonElement> CreateNodeAsync(
    CreateNodeParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Generic version
Task<T> CreateNodeAsync<T>(
    CreateNodeParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<NodeReference> CreateNodeInfoAsync(
    CreateNodeParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Create a new node instance in the specified main graph.

Parameters

Name type Description

graphName

string

Main image name

nodeName

string

node type name (obtained from GetAllNodesInfoAsync)

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, key fields:

field type Description

nodeId

string

The new node’s unique ID

nodeName

string

Node type name

timestamp

double

Timestamp of the graph after operation

example

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

await client.Graph.OpenGraphAsync("my_graph");

// Strongly typed version(Recommended)
var node = await client.Node.CreateNodeInfoAsync(
    new CreateNodeParams("my_graph", "ResizeImage"));
Console.WriteLine($"Node created successfully,ID: {node.NodeId}");
Console.WriteLine($"Request status: {node.Status}");

// original JsonElement version
var raw = await client.Node.CreateNodeAsync(new CreateNodeParams("my_graph", "DetectAndSegment"));
string nodeId = raw.GetProperty("nodeId").GetString()!;
Console.WriteLine($"Request status: {raw.GetProperty("status").GetInt32()}");

ConnectNodesAsync(…​)

// original JsonElement version
Task<JsonElement> ConnectNodesAsync(
    NodeConnectionParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Generic version
Task<T> ConnectNodesAsync<T>(
    NodeConnectionParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<NodeTimestampInfo> ConnectNodesInfoAsync(
    NodeConnectionParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Connect the ports of two nodes, data will flow from outputNode.outputPort to inputNode.inputPort.

Parameters

Name type Description

graphName

string

Main image name

outputNodeId

string

The node that generates data ID (upstream node)

outputPortName

string

The output port name of the upstream node

inputNodeId

string

The node that receives the data ID (downstream node)

inputPortName

string

Input port name of downstream node

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, containing the timestamp information after the operation.

example

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

await client.Graph.OpenGraphAsync("my_graph");

var resize = await client.Node.CreateNodeInfoAsync(new CreateNodeParams("my_graph", "ResizeImage"));
var detect = await client.Node.CreateNodeInfoAsync(new CreateNodeParams("my_graph", "DetectAndSegment"));
Console.WriteLine($"Node creation request status: resize={resize.Status}, detect={detect.Status}");

// will ResizeImage of output port connected to DetectAndSegment of image port
await client.Node.ConnectNodesInfoAsync(
    new NodeConnectionParams(
        "my_graph",
        outputNodeId: resize.NodeId, outputPortName: "resized_image", // upstream:ResizeImage
        inputNodeId: detect.NodeId, inputPortName: "image"));  // downstream:DetectAndSegment
Console.WriteLine("Node is connected");

Task<byte[]> GetPointsDataAsync(

Use: Read the point cloud data of the node port in binary format and return the original byte[].

Parameters

Name type Description

graphName

string

Main image name

string

cancellationToken

SetNodeParamDataAsync(…​)

// original JsonElement version
Task<JsonElement> SetNodeParamDataAsync(
    NodeParamUpdate paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Generic version
Task<T> SetNodeParamDataAsync<T>(
    NodeParamUpdate paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<NodeTimestampInfo> SetNodeParamDataInfoAsync(
    NodeParamUpdate paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Set a certain parameter value of the node. Supports basic types (string, numeric, boolean) and binary files (byte[]).

Parameters

Name type Description

graphName

string

Main image name

nodeId

string

Node ID

paramName

string

Parameter name

paramType

string

parameter type, usually "init_params" or "run_params"

value

object?

parameter value, supports string, numeric type, bool, byte[], FileInfo

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, containing post-operation timestamp information.

example

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

await client.Graph.OpenGraphAsync("my_graph");

// Set numerical parameters
await client.Node.SetNodeParamDataInfoAsync(
    new NodeParamUpdate(
        "my_graph", "resize-node-id", "scale_factor", "run_params", 0.5));

// Set string parameters
await client.Node.SetNodeParamDataAsync(
    new NodeParamUpdate(
        "my_graph", "model-node-id", "model_path", "init_params",
        "/models/resnet50.onnx"));

// Set file parameters(Such as model file)
await client.Node.SetNodeParamDataAsync(
    new NodeParamUpdate(
        "my_graph", "model-node-id", "model_file", "init_params",
        new FileInfo("/models/custom.onnx")));

Console.WriteLine("Parameter setting completed");

ActivateNodeAsync(…​)

// original JsonElement version(Polling waiting for completion)
Task<JsonElement> ActivateNodeAsync(
    NodeRef paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default,
    TimeSpan? timeout = null)

// Generic version
Task<T> ActivateNodeAsync<T>(
    NodeRef paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default,
    TimeSpan? timeout = null)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<NodeRunResult> ActivateNodeResultAsync(
    NodeRef paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default,
    TimeSpan? timeout = null)

Purpose: Activate and run the specified node, SDK polls internally until it returns after the run is completed. The default is to wait up to 30 seconds; if it exceeds timeout, throw AtomTimeoutException.

Parameters

Name type Description

graphName

string

Main image name

nodeId

string

Node ID

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, used by the caller to actively cancel

timeout

TimeSpan?

SDK polling wait timeout; null uses the default 30 seconds, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan means waiting forever

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, node operation result, including each output port data.

example

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

await client.Graph.OpenGraphAsync("my_graph");

var result = await client.Node.ActivateNodeResultAsync(
    new NodeRef("my_graph", "detect-node-id"),
    timeout: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60));
Console.WriteLine($"Node operation completed,Request status: {result.Status}");

// original JsonElement version(single request,No polling)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<NodeRunResult> UpdateNodeResultAsync(
    NodeRef paramsData,

PURPOSE: Update and run the node (triggers the node’s update/run logic). This interface only initiates one request as defined by the server UpdateNode and does not poll finish; if the server returns finish=false, SDK will also return this response directly to the caller.

Parameters

Name type Description

graphName

string

Main image name

nodeId

string

Node ID

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, used by the caller to actively cancel

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, node running result.

example

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

await client.Graph.OpenGraphAsync("my_graph");

var result = await client.Node.UpdateNodeResultAsync(
    new NodeRef("my_graph", "detect-node-id"));
Console.WriteLine($"Node update request returned,Request status: {result.Status}");

Complete example

The following example shows building and running a simple two-node pipeline in the main graph:

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Core;
using AtomSdk.Models;

class NodeWorkflowExample
{
    static async Task Main()
    {
        var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");
        const string graphName = "node_demo_graph";

        try
        {
            // 1. Create diagram and open
            var graphInfo = await client.Graph.CreateGraphInfoAsync(new CreateGraphParams(graphName));
            await client.Graph.OpenGraphAsync(graphName);
            Console.WriteLine($"[1] Diagram created and opened,Request status={graphInfo.Status}");

            // 2. Create two nodes
            var resizeNode = await client.Node.CreateNodeInfoAsync(new CreateNodeParams(graphName, "ResizeImage"));
            var detectNode = await client.Node.CreateNodeInfoAsync(new CreateNodeParams(graphName, "DetectAndSegment"));
            Console.WriteLine($"[2] Node has been created: resize={resizeNode.NodeId}, detect={detectNode.NodeId}, Request status={detectNode.Status}");

            // 3. settings ResizeImage parameters
            await client.Node.SetNodeParamDataAsync(
                new NodeParamUpdate(
                    graphName, resizeNode.NodeId, "scale_factor", "run_params", 0.5));
            Console.WriteLine("[3] Parameter setting completed");

            // 4. Connect nodes
            await client.Node.ConnectNodesAsync(
                new NodeConnectionParams(
                    graphName,
                    outputNodeId: resizeNode.NodeId, outputPortName: "resized_image",
                    inputNodeId: detectNode.NodeId, inputPortName: "image"));
            Console.WriteLine("[4] Node is connected");

            // 5. for DetectAndSegment Output port settings Runtime Binding name
            await client.Node.SetBindingNameAsync(
                new NodeBindingUpdate(
                    graphName, detectNode.NodeId, "outputs", "results", "result"));
            Console.WriteLine("[5] Binding name is set");

            // 6. Run the entire graph,most wait 30 seconds
            var runResult = await client.Graph.RunGraphResultAsync(
                graphName,
                timeout: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
            Console.WriteLine($"[6] Chart run completed,Request status: {runResult.Status}");

            // 7. Read output data
            var portData = await client.Node.GetNodePortDataAsync(
                new PortRef(graphName, detectNode.NodeId, "results", "outputs"));
            Console.WriteLine($"[7] Test results: {portData}");

            // 8. release chart
            await client.Graph.ReleaseGraphAsync(graphName);
            Console.WriteLine("[8] Image has been released");
        }
        catch (AtomApiException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Server error {ex.Status}: {ex.Message}");
        }
        catch (AtomHttpException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"HTTP Error {ex.StatusCode}: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}
